scope_note: Whitney and Lanman record that the commentary is not complete: "The commentary ('of Sayana') breaks off at the end of hymn 6 and we have no more of it till the beginning of book xi." (HOS vol. 8, at the head of book viii, in the editor's ell-brackets.) A query that finds no commentarial position in AV 8.7-10 must not read that as silence on the passages; the commentary is absent there.
